system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
The smaller box contains 20 tickets numbered from 1 to 20. The larger box contains 100 tickets numbered from 1 to 100.

[Image: Two boxes containing tickets]

Without looking at them, you can pick a ticket from either box. Which box would give you the greater chance of picking out a ticket with the number 17 on it?

Figure, described in words:
Two rectangular prism-shaped boxes drawn in perspective. The box on the left is smaller and labeled below as "20 tickets". The box on the right is noticeably larger and labeled below as "100 tickets".

A. The box with 20 tickets
B. The box with 100 tickets
C. Both boxes would give the same chance
D. It is impossible to tell

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: The smaller box gives a 1/20 chance of picking 17 versus 1/100 for the larger box, so the smaller box has the greater chance. The answer is A.
